summary: llm-d Router: The intelligent entry point for inference requests, designed to handle LLM inference traffic efficiently.
usecases: Handling inference requests for large language models
Kubernetes-based deployment for scalable AI inference services
Networking layer for connecting multiple AI model backends
ideas: Building a multi-model routing system that can dynamically select the best LLM backend for each request
Creating a unified API gateway that abstracts away complexity across different AI providers
Implementing auto-scaling mechanisms based on real-time inference load metrics
